tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch a ddbx filing
tools.description: The full thin-tier record for one id returned by search.

tools.name: get_company
tools.title: Insider activity at one company
tools.description: Recent insider dealings at one UK- or US-listed company, with a short description of the business and a link to its ddbx company page.

tools.name: get_daily_summary
tools.title: Daily insider-dealing summary
tools.description: ddbx's written recap of a trading day's insider dealings (UK or US), with the filings it cites. Omit date for the latest.

session.description: afternoon is the end-of-day recap; morning covers the opening session.

tools.name: get_dealing
tools.title: Get one insider dealing
tools.description: One filing by the id returned from search_dealings or get_company (e.g. "UK:…", "US:f4-…").

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search ddbx
tools.description: Find recent insider dealings at a company by name or ticker (UK and US). Returns ids to pass to fetch.

tools.name: search_dealings
tools.title: Search insider dealings
tools.description: List recent insider share dealings in one market, newest first. By default only filings ddbx rated as signal (significant, noteworthy or minor); set signal_only=false for every screened open-market filing. Filter by ticker and by disclosure date.

market.description: UK = LSE directors; US = SEC Form 4 insiders; SE = Sweden; NL = Netherlands; USG = members of the US Congress.

since.description: Only filings disclosed on or after this date.

before.description: Only filings disclosed before this date (use to page back).
